versions.content: Pre-compile time configuration of BSW Type: valid Description: The configuration of parameters of BSW at pre-compile time shall be possible for configuration parameters that are defined to be pre-compile time configurable. Rationale: Some AUTOSAR BSW module's configuration parameters are defined to be pre-compile time configurable for efficiency reasons. The ECU Configuration needs to support those parameters. Use Case: Support of pre-compile time configuration parameters. 5 21 of 35  AUTOSAR CONFIDENTIAL  Document ID 85: AUTOSAR_RS_ECUConfiguration Requirements on ECU Configuration AUTOSAR CP R19-11 4 Dependencies:  Supporting Material: AUTOSAR Glossary [5]
